scope: Development runs of the same ten-request synthetic workflow, not a frozen comparative benchmark or independent user acceptance. Fixes followed observed failures. Earlier original cache manifests and recordings were not overwritten.
accounting: Reported totals include captured provider receipts only. Missing costs are null or explicitly incomplete, never assumed zero. No token-savings claim follows from these runs.
